HEADLINE
maximize ROI by identifying unused tools

For b2b finance professionals, waste money on unused SaaS subscriptions.

An AI messaging workspace that turns rough product thinking into positioning, landing copy, and UX drafts.

WHO IT IS FOR
B2B finance professionals

waste money on unused SaaS subscriptions

WHY EXISTING TOOLS FAIL

provides actionable insights for cost optimization.

KEY BENEFITS

ux.text:
UX CONTEXT
TARGET: product
Subscription tracker for B2B finance professionals helps identify unused SaaS subscriptions and maximize ROI.

ONBOARDING
1. Connect your account to start tracking.
2. Set up your profile to get started.
3. Import existing subscriptions to begin analysis.

EMPTY STATE
1. No subscriptions found yet. Add some to get started!
2. Your subscription list is empty. Start adding tools today!
3. You haven't connected an account yet. Link one now!

ERROR
1. Unable to import subscription data. Check your CSV file format.
2. Connection error: ensure your account credentials are correct.
3. Subscription not found: try searching again or check the spelling.

TOAST
1. Subscriptions imported!
2. Profile set up successfully!
3. Account connected!

BUTTON LABELS
1. Track My Subscriptions
2. Update My Profile
3. Connect My Account
4. Add New Subscription
5. Remove Unused Tools
6. Review My Results
7. Edit My Settings
8. Save My Progress

slots.empty_state: No subscriptions tracked yet. Connect your account to start.
slots.helper_text: List your SaaS tools — what they do and who uses them.
slots.error_message: Data failed to load. Check that all accounts are connected.
